title: Locked: Browser White with toolbar
question: This is what I'll build. Press Build this to confirm, or add a last note in the steer box first. The build covers the homepage, results page and settings, every instant answer, light and dark themes, and phones as well as desktops.

options.label: Browser White with toolbar
options.thesis: A white page that feels like the web people know: underlined blue links, visited purple, Redaction (a Times-style serif), monospace addresses. The browser era lives in the controls: a pale grey toolbar band, sunken fields, raised buttons, grooved rules. Images stay in full colour. Your lockup exactly as drawn; your mark is the favicon; the leaning blue book rocks once while results load.
options.viewport: Toolbar band with your lockup, sunken search field and Search; grooved rule; results with a full-colour image strip; topic panel as a raised plate on wide screens and after the first result on phones.
options.risk: Its character rests on the bevels, rules and type being crisp everywhere, including every instant-answer card.
